title: Model spend ceiling counts the current turn's unreconciled gateway observations
description:
The ceiling reads the cost index, so one long turn can pass the ceiling before its calls are reconciled. Count the current turn's unreconciled gateway observations in the ceiling check. See docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md 3.12.

Feature: Ceiling includes in-flight turn spend
  Scenario: A long turn cannot slip past the ceiling
    Given an organization just under its monthly model spend ceiling
    And a turn whose gateway calls are not yet reconciled
    When the unreconciled observations push spend over the ceiling
    Then the next model call returns 403 model_spend_ceiling_reached
right_now_summary: The ceiling check now includes unreconciled gateway observations from the current turn.
